title: feat(triage): evaluate rule custom checks from pull request facts
body:
Typed rule custom checks (paths unchanged, paths together, title and branch patterns, label required, diff excludes, minimum approvals) were accepted by the pack and shown in the editor but never evaluated, so an action referencing one was skipped as "off in this pack".

## What changed

- `logic/rule-checks.ts` evaluates each rule kind from facts, with evidence and a finding on failure. A missing branch, or a clean scan with unscanned additions, is unconfirmed; a hit in a truncated patch still fails. Diff evidence is `path:line` only.
- `classificationSources` lists rule rows so the verdict names them; results carry the check name, so no raw `custom-n` reaches the comment, the merge reasons or the portal.
- Next steps per rule: retitle, rename branch, revert paths, also change paths, remove excluded content for the author; add label and approve for the maintainer. Evidence in the author comment posts as inline code.
- The glob matcher moves to `logic/glob.ts`.

## Verification

- `bun run check`, logic and contract tests, portal tests.
- Live local sidecar run on a pack with four rule checks and an action gated on the title rule: all four evaluated with evidence, the action resolved to its "no" branch with the comment Do, the verdict and comment named each rule, and merge read "not recommended" with per-rule reasons.

Refs CL-XXXX
